args.body:
File: docs/CONFIG.md

The issue is about the setup steps missing mention of setting S3_ENDPOINT for MinIO uploads. The file docs/CONFIG.md documents the configuration variables including S3_ENDPOINT but the feedback is the setup guide lacks this. This file needs an update to mention setting S3_ENDPOINT in the local setup steps so uploads go to MinIO, addressing the reported issue.
